panels.description: Free activity slots in the worker pool. Configured max_concurrent_activities = 50. Low = worker saturated.
panels.title: Free activity slots

panels.description: Time to run one activity (process_item).
panels.title: Activity execution latency

panels.description: How long an activity waits in the queue before a worker picks it up. Rising = not enough worker capacity.
panels.title: Activity schedule-to-start

panels.description: Time the worker spends executing one workflow task (replaying history + running code).
panels.title: Workflow task execution latency

panels.description: Total wall-clock time from workflow start to completion.
panels.title: Workflow end-to-end latency

panels.description: Free slots per worker pool. ActivityWorker starts at max_concurrent_activities (50). Hitting 0 = the worker is the bottleneck.
panels.title: Available task slots

panels.description: Slots currently in use per worker pool (in-flight tasks).
panels.title: Used task slots (in-flight)

panels.description: Active pollers pulling tasks from the task queue, per poller type.
panels.title: Active pollers

panels.description: Workflows cached on this worker (sticky execution). Avoids replaying full history every task.
panels.title: Sticky cache size

panels.description: Fraction of workflow tasks served from the sticky cache (no full replay). Higher is better.
panels.title: Sticky cache hit ratio

panels.description: Rate of gRPC calls the worker makes to the Temporal frontend, by operation.
panels.title: Request rate by operation

panels.description: Failed gRPC calls to the Temporal server. Non-zero can mean connectivity or server-side issues.
panels.title: Request failures by operation

panels.description: Total workflows completed since the worker started, per workflow type.
panels.title: Workflow completions by type

panels.description: Total activity executions since the worker started, per activity type.
panels.title: Activity executions by type

panels.description: Workflow and activity executions grouped by task queue.
panels.title: Executions by task queue

panels.description: Workflow tasks waiting in the queue, not yet picked up by a worker.
panels.title: Workflow backlog

panels.description: Activity tasks waiting in the queue, not yet picked up by a worker.
panels.title: Activity backlog

panels.description: Tasks waiting in the queue over time, by type. Rising = work arrives faster than the worker drains it.
panels.title: Backlog count over time

panels.description: Tasks added to vs dispatched from the queue. When add > dispatch the backlog grows.
panels.title: Add vs dispatch rate

panels.description: Age of the oldest task still waiting in the queue.
panels.title: Oldest task age in backlog

panels.description: Worker process CPU usage. Can exceed 100% on multi-core machines.
panels.title: Worker process CPU

panels.description: Whole-host CPU usage.
panels.title: Host CPU

panels.description: Worker process resident memory.
panels.title: Worker memory (RSS)

panels.description: Disk usage on the worker host.
panels.title: Disk used

panels.description: Worker process vs whole-host CPU over time.
panels.title: CPU over time (per worker)

panels.description: Worker process memory and open file descriptors / threads.
panels.title: Memory, threads & FDs (per worker)

panels.description: Workflow tasks that failed on the worker (non-determinism, panics), by reason. Should normally be flat at 0.
panels.title: Workflow task failures by reason

panels.description: How often pollers come back empty vs with work. High empty-poll rate = worker idle / queue starved.
panels.title: Poll efficiency

panels.description: Workflows evicted from the sticky cache because it was full. Non-zero = cache too small for the number of live workflows (forces history replay).
panels.title: Sticky cache forced evictions

panels.description: Time spent replaying workflow history on cache miss.
panels.title: Workflow task replay latency

panels.description: gRPC round-trip latency from the worker to the Temporal frontend, p95 by operation.
panels.title: gRPC request latency (p95)

panels.description: Activity throughput split by worker — which worker is pulling more load.
panels.title: Activity executions /s by worker

panels.description: In-flight activity slots per worker. Shows how full each worker's pool is.
panels.title: Used activity slots by worker

panels.description: Workflow completions split by worker.
panels.title: Workflow completions /s by worker

panels.description: Number of pollers (workers) the server sees serving this task queue, by type. Should match how many workers you have running.
panels.title: Pollers serving the queue

panels.description: Items processed per second by outcome, from the custom counter in activities.py (success / transient_error / permanent_error).
panels.title: Item outcomes /s

panels.description: Executions split by attempt number — attempt 2/3 means Temporal retried a transient failure.
panels.title: Executions by attempt (retries)

panels.description: Cumulative item outcomes since the workers started.
panels.title: Total items by outcome
